veranderings.blok: Die kyk bly jou eie werk
veranderings.voor: en die kyk bly jou werk
veranderings.na: en jy moet self bly kyk
veranderings.rede: 'Die kyk' as a noun for the act of looking is wooden in running Afrikaans; the verb form says the same thing naturally (the heading, which cannot change, keeps its own wording).

veranderings.voor: 'n Tonnel onder 'n pad of 'n spoor waardeur mense loop.
veranderings.na: 'n Tonnel waardeur mense onder 'n pad of 'n spoor loop.
veranderings.rede: 'waardeur' stands right after 'n spoor', so it can read as people walking through the railway; moving the relative next to 'Tonnel' makes the reference clear without changing the meaning.
